description: Rewrite both fractions as equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Add (or subtract) the numerators of the two common-denominator fractions, keeping the denominator unchanged.
Subtract the numerators of the two common-denominator fractions, keeping the denominator unchanged.
Compare the two fractions using <, >, or = — e.g. '1/4 < 1/6'.
Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms (or restate it unchanged if already in lowest terms).
Write the final answer as a fraction, mixed number, or whole number.
